svg.title: Roseau — Phragmites australis
svg.desc: A common reed with a tall, slender, jointed hollow culm, overlapping leaf sheaths, and long parallel-veined blades arching downward. Its open tawny and muted purple panicle divides repeatedly into fine branches bearing silky narrow spikelets. A short creeping rhizome and a few fibrous roots remain at the base.
